llm_response.reason: The website claims to sell branded products (Quiksilver) but displays several scam signals: recently registered domain with all WHOIS details redacted, ambiguous privacy information, no visible company address or verified contact details, urgency-based sales tactics, and mimicking of legitimate brand identity. These match multiple criteria for scam sites, especially the lack of credible business identification and suspicious mimicry of Quiksilver’s e-commerce offerings.
